items.title: Delhi Police registered a case against Saurav Das and Ashutosh Ranka for unauthorized trespassing at Jantar Mantar (RVCJ Media citing ANI)
items.summary: Verified RVCJ Media IG carousel (13M followers; posted 16:04:44Z) reports Delhi Police registered a case against CJP co-conveners Saurav Das and Ashutosh Ranka for unauthorized trespassing at Jantar Mantar over Tuesday morning's gate-climb entry, citing ANI tweet screenshots; both remain detained. Note: earlier Tuesday reporting (haldialive, citing India Today ~9 AM IST) said police were only 'considering' an FIR with no confirmation - escalation to a registered case still single-sourced. Distinct from the 4 FIRs over Monday's INDIA-bloc march to the SC.
